description: Switch 1 flipped (its trapdoor open) and basket 1 at 5 of 6: a size-3 C and a size-2 B resting in it, made of the five ledge sleepers above the switch. The first slime rides the loop just before the switch: it drops in, the basket fills, fires and opens gate 1 (the loop grows into section 2). For frontier sets (chunk 14).
